orderbook_depth.method: Each hourly column averages one-minute book snapshots. Full-depth venues are Coinbase, Bitstamp, Bitfinex and Gemini; OKX and Kraken add near-price depth. USDT books are converted to USD using a live USDT/USD rate.
limitations: Binance and Bitget are excluded, so the largest spot venue by volume is absent.
Displayed resting orders can be cancelled; hidden and iceberg orders are not shown.
Hourly averaging dilutes short-lived walls; the snapshot is not a point-in-time executable quote.
No raw per-venue book snapshots or fill-probability model were captured in this run.

derivatives.cache_status: UNKNOWN; the 13:03 retrieval returned the same provider timestamp and payload as the 12:40 market snapshot. No cache headers were exposed.

spot_context.limitation: The prior Kraken/OKX spot snapshot is asynchronous; OKX was stale and Kraken lacked provider event time. No new spot quote was admitted in this run.

cryptokeyhole.daily_fund_universe: Four daily issuer-file readers out of six listed funds.
cryptokeyhole.date_anomaly: The page says its latest issuer file is dated 2026-11-09 but read at 2026-11-07T05:12Z, a future-dated issuer-file label relative to the 2026-11-08 reference. Quarantine that latest-file date until publisher correction or issuer confirmation.
cryptokeyhole.definition: Daily change in XRP held; publisher's description includes creations/redemptions, retained staking rewards where applicable, and XRP sold for fees or cash payouts. It is not a pure net-creation series.

holdhub.interpretation: Holdings rose while net assets fell, demonstrating that NAV/net assets are not a direct flow proxy. Hold Hub is a secondary review of issuer pages and SoSoValue, not an issuer filing.

alpha_finance.upstream: CoinGlass, per Alpha Finance's dashboard methodology.

why_not_comparable: CryptoKeyhole computes changes in XRP held from selected issuer files and includes fee sales/cash payouts in its definition.
Hold Hub reports that issuer pages did not publish daily dollar flow fields in its November 6 review; SoSoValue cumulative figures lacked an as-of date.
Alpha Finance uses a five-fund CoinGlass-fed dashboard; its universe and upstream differ from CryptoKeyhole's four-fund daily reader.
The CryptoKeyhole 9 November issuer-file date is future-dated relative to the 8 November capture and is quarantined.
A zero aggregator flow can mean no update or no flow; issuer shares/holdings and aligned NAV are needed to distinguish them.
etf_flow_reconciliation.source_independence: These publishers are separate interfaces but rely on overlapping issuer disclosures and aggregator inputs. They are not independent confirmations of primary-market XRP capital.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Displayed six-venue spot depth is bid-skewed near the snapshot mid.
competing_hypotheses.support: Fuelmaps shows 56.5% bid share within 1% and 69.7% within 5%.
competing_hypotheses.counterevidence: Binance and Bitget are excluded; hourly averages and cancellable resting orders are not executable demand.

competing_hypotheses.claim: The bid skew may not persist or may be dominated by venue coverage and transient quotes.
competing_hypotheses.support: Near-price depth includes only a subset of full-depth venues at wider bands; hidden liquidity and cancellations are unobserved.
competing_hypotheses.counterevidence: The composite covers all six reporting venues within 5% at the snapshot.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Perpetual positioning is mildly positive-carry but not demonstrably crowded.
competing_hypotheses.counterevidence: Mark is 3.113 bps below index and open interest/liquidations are unavailable; the response is stale.

competing_hypotheses.claim: ETF data does not currently provide a clean directional capital-flow signal.
competing_hypotheses.support: CryptoKeyhole, Hold Hub and Alpha Finance differ in fund universe, update timing and measurement definition.
competing_hypotheses.counterevidence: Some issuer holdings/share data can later support a reconstructed creation/redemption estimate if dates and NAV are aligned.

disconfirming_evidence: The bid-heavy Fuelmaps composite is a single third-party snapshot and omits Binance/Bitget.
Resting bids may be cancelled; the data do not prove buyers executed at those levels.
The Binance premium-index payload is 1,642 seconds old at the reference time, beyond the 300-second freshness threshold.
No open-interest, liquidation or raw per-venue order-book data were captured.
CryptoKeyhole's reported latest issuer-file date is future-dated relative to the capture.
Hold Hub's Franklin example shows holdings up while net assets down, disconfirming the use of net assets as a demand proxy.

model_admission.reason: Depth is an hourly third-party composite with venue exclusions and no raw per-venue receipt; Binance derivatives payload is stale; ETF flow measures are methodologically unresolved.
model_admission.eligible_future_use: Research-only context pending synchronized point-in-time raw per-venue depth, fresh derivatives OI/funding, issuer-aligned shares/holdings/NAV and validated flow definitions.
